engine.notes: Imposters is effectively the whole training scene; Something Dada, Cleveland's longest-running troupe (since 1994), performs at the Beck Center but has no website of its own, and Cleveland Improv, Hilarities and the Funny Bone are stand-up rooms.

entries.name: Imposters Theater
entries.summary: Ohio City's home for improv, sketch and alternative comedy: a five-level improv program, sketch, stand-up and storytelling classes, house-team Harold Night, two free weekly jams and shows every Friday and Saturday.
entries.schedule: Shows Thu-Sat; Harold Night Thursdays 7 pm; Wednesday Jam 8 pm; Saturday Improv Jam 1-3 pm; six-week classes $199
signals: Five improv levels, six weeks each
entries.reasons: The full package of a training theater, with levels, house teams, weekly jams and a dated calendar, scored below the big-city veterans only because it is five years old.

entries.name: Beck Center for the Arts
entries.summary: Long-established Lakewood arts center that runs a six-week Adult Improv: The Basics class each semester in its theater education program and is the home stage of the Something Dada troupe.
entries.schedule: Adult Improv: The Basics, Thursdays 7:15 pm; terms Sept 10-Oct 15 and Nov 5-Dec 17, 2026, $95
entries.reasons: A permanent institution with a dated, affordable beginner class, but only one level, no path to performing, and improv is a sideline of a general arts school.
